meta.name: watch
meta.description: Watch a rendered video (whole file or specific ranges) at a chosen fidelity and emit a timestamp-keyed observation report. Observation only — no edits, no verdicts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观看视频并生成带时间戳的观察报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要仔细查看视频内容并记录关键时间点
copy.tagline_en: Watch a video and generate a timestamped observation report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to examine video content and record key timestamps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以观看本地视频文件，按时间戳生成观察报告，描述画面、语音、音乐和音效，但不做评价或修改。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 观看一段视频并报告内容时触发，例如指定视频路径、时间范围或关注点。

say.text: 请观看这个视频，告诉我画面里发生了什么。
say.note: Claude 会生成带时间戳的观察报告。

say.text: 只看视频最后30秒，注意文字是否清晰。
say.note: Claude 会缩小范围并提高分辨率。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can watch a local video file and produce a timestamp-keyed observation report describing visuals, voiceover, music, and sound effects, without making judgments or edits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to watch a video and report its content, e.g., by specifying a video path, time ranges, or focus areas.

say_en.text: Watch this video and tell me what happens on screen.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a timestamped observation report.

say_en.text: Only watch the last 30 seconds, focusing on text legibility.
say_en.note: Claude will narrow the range and increase resolution.
